status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Brooks (groin) remained a full participant in Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
status.longComment: Brooks is still on injured reserve but appears to be tracking toward a Week 11 return against Baltimore on Sunday. Chuba Hubbard should remain head-and-shoulders above Brooks on the depth chart as the clear RB1 for Carolina, but the Panthers likely also want to use the rest of the season to see if Brooks can stay healthy for a stretch and produce when given opportunities. Brooks is worth adding in fantasy, but his role will need to be defined before plugging him in lineups.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Tremble (knee) was limited in Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
status.longComment: Both Tremble and Darren Waller (knee) were upgraded to limited work after being DNP on Wednesday. Friday's participation levels and injury designations will tell a better story for their Week 11 availability versus Baltimore. Mitchell Evans, Feleipe Franks and Ja'Tavion Sanders are next in line at tight end for Carolina.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Waller (knee) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN reports.
status.longComment: One day removed from being a non-participant Wednesday due to a knee injury, Waller was able to mix into some drills, but he now has just one more chance to get back to full Friday, at which point his odds to suit up Sunday against the Ravens will become known.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Christensen (hamstring) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
status.longComment: Christensen drew the questionable tag for Sunday's game against the Saints after logging a trio of full practices. However, he's not quite ready to return from a hamstring injury, and his next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Okereke (foot) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
status.longComment: Okereke has been sidelined for each of the Panthers' last two games while recovering from a foot injury, which has also prevented him from practicing. He has two more chances to return to practice in at least a limited capacity ahead of Sunday's home game against the Ravens. Tyrel Dodson has stepped into a starting role at inside linebacker in Okereke's absence.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Jackson (groin) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
status.longComment: Jackson's 21-day practice window opened Wednesday, and he drew the doubtful tag for Sunday's game after logging a trio of limited sessions. He's not quite ready to return from a groin injury that landed him on IR in late September, and his next opportunity to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22.
